summary: The company, Controladora Vuela Compania de Aviacion (Volaris), filed a 6-K reporting April 2026 monthly traffic results: RPMs rose 1.6% and ASMs fell 1.9%, yielding a consolidated load factor of 84.6% (+2.9pp y-o-y). No transaction, special event, or corporate action is present—only a routine operational update of a foreign private issuer. This is a normal periodic 6-K filing (traffic statistics), not a special situation.
